title: Senior Red Team Specialist
description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Red Team Specialist to join our dynamic cybersecurity team in Maharashtra. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in offensive security practices, including penetration testing and red teaming methodologies. As a Senior Red Team Specialist, you will play a crucial role in identifying vulnerabilities within our systems and applications, simulating real-world attacks, and providing actionable insights to enhance our security posture. Key Responsibilities: - Conduct comprehensive penetration tests on various systems, networks, and applications to identify security weaknesses. - Develop and execute red team engagements to simulate advanced persistent threats and assess the effectiveness of our security controls. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to communicate findings and recommend remediation strategies. - Stay updated on the latest security threats, vulnerabilities, and industry best practices to continuously improve our offensive security capabilities. - Mentor and guide junior team members in red teaming techniques and methodologies. Required Skills: - Strong knowledge of red teaming and offensive security principles. - Proficiency in penetration testing tools and frameworks. - Experience with network and application security assessments. - Familiarity with scripting and programming languages to automate tasks and develop custom tools. - Excellent communication skills to effectively convey technical findings to non-technical stakeholders. If you are passionate about cybersecurity and have a proven track record in offensive security, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity to make a significant impact on our organization's security landscape.
  
  
This job is provided by Shine.com

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Ahy Consulting is a progressive development agency specializing in eCommerce growth, backed by 17 years of industry experience. The team has witnessed and adapted to the evolution of the internet, building strategies that drive measurable results for clients. Since 2018, Ahy Consulting has achieved an average 35% increase in conversions within the first six months across its eCommerce support projects. Operational processes are designed to enable sustainable growth and scale, challenging both internal teams and business owners to reach ambitious goals. More information about the company and its services is available at www.ahyconsulting.com.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Senior DevSecOps Engineer is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Kalyan Dombivli. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining secure CI/CD pipelines, integrating security controls into every stage of the software development lifecycle. The engineer will manage cloud and on\-premise infrastructure, automate deployments, monitor system performance, and ensure compliance with security best practices and standards. Daily tasks include collaborating with development and operations teams, performing vulnerability assessments, managing incident response, and improving tooling and processes for reliability, scalability, and security. The role also involves mentoring team members, documenting procedures, and contributing to architectural decisions that support eCommerce growth.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Computer Science principles, including data structures, algorithms, and system design.
* Proficiency in Back\-End Web Development and Software Development, with experience building and maintaining APIs and microservices.
* Advanced Programming skills in one or more languages commonly used in DevSecOps environments (e.g., Python, Go, Java, or similar).
* Solid understanding of Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) concepts and their application in secure, maintainable codebases.
* Hands\-on experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI, GitHub Actions) and infrastructure\-as\-code frameworks (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
* Experience implementing security practices across the SDLC, including code scanning, dependency management, and container security.
* Practical knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and Linux\-based systems administration.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams, communicate clearly, and document processes and standards.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in eCommerce or high\-traffic web applications is an advantage; relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, OSCP, CSSLP) are a plus.

title: Cyber Security Trainer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Shorat Innovations Pvt Ltd is a technology company offering services in software development, mobile app development, web development, social media marketing, and graphic design. The organization focuses on delivering innovative, growth\-oriented solutions tailored to diverse business needs. In addition to its service offerings, Shorat Innovations provides corporate training programs in areas such as Java Full Stack, Python Full Stack, Data Science, Android Development, and Flutter Development. The company’s expert team conducts training, workshops, and internships to help students and professionals build in\-demand skills in the evolving tech industry. Shorat Innovations emphasizes excellence, creativity, and customer satisfaction, positioning itself as a trusted partner for comprehensive technology and training solutions.
   

**Role Description** 
 The Cyber Security Trainer will design, develop, and deliver engaging training programs on core cybersecurity topics for students and professionals. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include preparing course materials, creating hands\-on labs and practical exercises, conducting classroom sessions, assessing learner performance, and updating content based on current industry trends and threats. The trainer will collaborate with internal teams to align training with organizational standards, provide mentoring and guidance to learners, and participate in workshops or seminars as required. This is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Maharashtra, India, requiring consistent classroom presence and interaction with learners.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Cybersecurity and Information Security, with the ability to explain concepts clearly to diverse audiences.
* Hands\-on experience with Network Security, including secure network design, monitoring, and incident response.
* Practical knowledge of Application Security practices such as secure coding, vulnerability assessment, and remediation.
* Experience or familiarity with Malware Analysis techniques and tools used to detect and analyze malicious software.
* Prior experience in technical training, teaching, or mentoring in a cybersecurity or IT domain is highly beneficial.
* Relevant certifications (e.g., CEH, CompTIA Security\+, CISSP, OSCP) are an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to create inclusive learning environments.
* Ability to design structured curricula, develop training materials, and adapt content for different skill levels.
* Willingness to stay updated with emerging security threats, tools, and best practices, and reflect these in training programs.
